title: City of Syracuse Issues Alert on Nationwide Zoning and Planning Scam
summary: The City of Syracuse has issued a public alert regarding a nationwide zoning and planning scam targeting residents and businesses with fraudulent notices demanding immediate payments and threatening fines. Mayor Owens clarified that the City's Zoning Administration will never demand immediate payment without proper verification, and directed the public to verify communications directly with the Zoning office or report suspicious activity to the FBI's IC3.

political_signal.description: Public safety and consumer protection messaging; positioning city government as transparent and protective of constituents against fraud schemes.
